newsitem.title: USA: U.S. cash soymeal - Crush seen slowing in late June.
newsitem.headline: U.S. cash soymeal - Crush seen slowing in late June.

text.p: Soymeal basis values were mostly steady Thursday with business largely limited to a few "hand-to-mouth" purchases, dealers said.
They said prices for early July delivery were around $4.00 higher than spot delivery amid sentiment that the crush pace looks set to slow later this month.

The current crush pace, however, remains comparatively strong with trade estimates for the National Oilseed Processors Association weekly crush ranging from 24.5 million to 25.4 million bushels, only slightly below last week's surprisingly high 25.46 million.

"Margins are slipping and beans are getting tighter. They (crushers) are going to crush while the margins are decent," one dealer said, noting margins for early July were currently looking unattractive.
